product_name: Bajaj Life Linked New Critical Illness Benefit Rider
regulatory_descriptor: A Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider
key_benefits: Critical Illness lump-sum benefit — on first diagnosis of a covered critical illness, the Rider Sum Assured is paid in lump sum, subject to the Life Assured surviving 14 days from confirmed diagnosis
Choice of 3 options covering 10 / 25 / 60 major critical illnesses (Critical / Enhanced / Comprehensive)
Women-specific illness coverage in each option (cancer relating to breast, corpus uteri, cervix uteri, ovary, vulva, vagina)
Health Management Services while the rider is in force
Tax benefit as per prevailing income tax laws

eligibility.policy_term: Rider Policy Term and Rider PPT must align with the base policy term and base PPT; numeric range not captured in this parse
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Aligned to base policy (single / limited / regular); numeric range not captured
eligibility.note: This is a LINKED (unit-linked) RIDER attachable to a base policy. One of three options (Critical/Enhanced/Comprehensive) chosen at inception. Eligibility boundary table not recovered from this parse.

key_terms.free_look_note: Free look period is as per the base policy (commonly 30 days) — verify against the base policy / rider document.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Not separately stated for this pure-risk health rider in this parse — handled per base policy; verify against rider policy document.
key_terms.survival_period_note: Benefit is payable only if the Life Assured survives 14 days from the date of confirmed diagnosis; a waiting period and survival-period exclusion apply.
key_terms.loan_note: No loan / no maturity benefit — pure risk health rider.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per prevailing income tax laws as amended — consult a tax advisor. GST/cess collected over and above the premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Free Look Period (as per base policy)

claims_marketing_must_support: The number of critical illnesses covered (10 / 25 / 60) is option-dependent (Critical / Enhanced / Comprehensive) — any '60 critical illnesses' claim is valid ONLY for the Comprehensive option and must be option-qualified.
Payout is conditional on first diagnosis AND the Life Assured surviving 14 days from confirmed diagnosis, and is subject to waiting/survival-period exclusions.
Women-specific cover is included in each option (not an add-on).
Rider Sum Assured is paid on a covered CI claim — it is a protection benefit, not a return.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market this as a standalone product — it is a rider that MUST reference and be attached to an eligible base policy.
Do NOT advertise '60 critical illnesses' without specifying the Comprehensive option, nor imply all illnesses are covered from day one (waiting and 14-day survival periods apply).
Do NOT position as an investment, savings, maturity or money-back product — it is a pure-risk health rider with no maturity benefit and no loan, despite being a 'Linked' rider.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'as per prevailing income tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Rider UIN 116A060V01 and reference to the base policy it is attached to
Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider'
The chosen option (Critical/Enhanced/Comprehensive) and the applicable waiting/survival-period conditions whenever the CI count is claimed
Standard disclaimer to read the rider sales literature with the benefit illustration and policy document

gaps: Numeric entry/maturity age, rider sum-assured and rider-term boundary table not recovered from this parse.
Free-look days inherited from base policy (not stated explicitly in the rider leaflet).
